text:
mira: Morning — quick sync: we want to run a short pricing page experiment next week combining: (1) an FAQ refresh that highlights Dedicated vs Private, (2) two tier-name variants (’Starter / Scale / Enterprise’ vs ’Dev / Team / Committed’), and (3) a compact calculator microflow for committed capacity. goal: measure sign-up CTR, inbound lead quality, and webinar signups. :rocket:

jess: love it. for the FAQ copy, can we surface a 1-sentence ROI line for Dedicated? e.g., ‘Predictable throughput, fixed unit costs for heavy production.’ two variants for microcopy too? :thinking_face:

mark: analytics: we should track `pricing_page_variant`, `calculator_opened`, `calc_committed_estimate`, and `lead_source`. i'll add GTM events and a filter in Amplitude. sam, can you own the UTM + GTM naming?

sam: yep — i’ll standardize names. proposed GTM snippet: ```event: pricing_experiment_launch, properties: { variant: "tier_a"|"tier_b", calc_flow: "compact_v1", webinar_optin: true }``` will push to amplitude

carol: routing: if someone uses the calculator and selects >$5k/mo, route to sales queue A (account-exec), else route to inbound SDR. will add mapping in Intercom playbook. also want a webhook for dedicated interest tags.

mira: perfect. timeline: draft copy by Tue EOD, dev hook + GTM by Thu, internal QA Fri, soft launch Mon. does that work for everyone? :calendar:

jess: i’ll drop two copy options in the doc today — short vs explanatory. linking Notion: https://notion.so/rw/pricing-exp-brief :link:

mark: quick ask — can we also log `webinar_source` for anyone who signs up from the pricing page? helps attribution for the webinar play.

sam: yes — will add `webinar_source: pricing_page_v1` to the event payload.

carol: FYI sales ops wants a CSV export nightly for leads flagged as ‘high-commitment’. adding that to the playbook now.

in aisha (deploy-bot): Deploy scheduled: staging/pricing-experiment -> Thu 18:00 UTC by @sam :white_check_mark:

mira: reminder: copy lock Wed morning so creative can finalize assets for the hero and micro-calculator. jess — please call out any legal flags for tier names (’Committed’ might imply contract).

jess: noted — i'll run the names by legal and record the approval in the doc.

mark: final thought — add a tiny survey after calc submission: 1 question ‘What are you trying to build?’ gives better lead qualification. short free-text. agrees? :eyes:

carol: yes — and include an opt-in checkbox for the webinar. default unchecked.

mira: sweet. i’ll consolidate next steps in the brief and ping stakeholders. thanks all :tada:
